//: SCP-294 CONSUMPTION EFFECTS.  Every custom liquid the machine can dispense carries a `consumption_effect_on_conditions` pointing here (see items/scp_294_items.json).  These are ordinary EOCs - alpha is the drinker, run on the consume path - modelled on the base game's own inline consumption EOCs (data/json/items/comestibles/dairy.json:148).
//2: DESIGN NOTE: hazard here is a SCALD/FREEZE, not a death.  Molten gold and liquid nitrogen hurt badly and can put a careless survivor in real trouble, but the numbers are chosen to wound, not to execute - consistent with how this mod treats its anomalies (severity, not lethality).

effect.u_message: You get it down.  You do not get it to stay down.

//: MOLTEN GOLD.  The 'cup of gold' gag is deliberately a HAZARD and not a payday: the metal is priced at nothing (price 0 in the item), so it is not a currency faucet, and drinking it is a serious burn.

effect.u_message: It goes down like a swallowed coal and keeps going, all the way down.

//: LIQUID NITROGEN.  Cold damage plus a long frostbite - the cup is fine, the drinker is not.

effect.u_message: It is not cold so much as it is the end of warmth, and it is going down your throat.

//: 'SURPRISE ME'.  Water heated past the point of staying water; it flashes to steam and scalds.  Smaller than the gold because the cup barely made it to you.

effect.u_message: The heat of it arrives before the taste does, and the taste does not arrive.
You are not hearing it.  You are feeling it, and you are already moving to it.
Everything that has ever happened to you arrives at once, and stays.
You know what to do.  You do not remember learning it, and you will not remember it later.

//: THE PERFECT DRINK.  The morale point is applied with capped:true so it accumulates linearly; -60 with a -99 floor is a genuinely serious, long mood collapse, and the despair status is the visible half.  NO lethal or self-harm mechanic - the article's outcome is referenced by the flavour, not enacted on the player.

effect.u_message: It is the best thing you have ever tasted.  You already know you will never have it again.
